svg.aria-label: A robot with arms spread presents at a podium beside a tall screen showing a rising chart topped by a skull with X eyes and teeth, plus a stack of dollar bills, labeled Extinction Risk. To the right, a person stands with a neutral, unimpressed look beside a speech bubble reading Just a pitch.
